تبتسروا (form VIII)
# تَبْتَسِرُوا (tabtasirū) /tab.ta.si.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
# تُبْتَسَرُوا (tubtasarū) /tub.ta.sa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
